== Triage

Categories:: personal-data-breach
Severity:: medium
Occurred at:: 2025-09-07T21:00:00Z
Detected at:: 2025-09-08T06:40:00Z
Aware at:: 2025-09-08T07:30:00Z
Personal data affected:: yes
NIS2 significant:: no
Affected services:: service:notification-service
Tickets:: SEC-1544

== Privacy assessment

Data subjects::
* Category: Subscribers; Approximate number: 950

Records approximate:: 950
Risk:: high-risk
Risk assessment:: The addresses of all subscribers were visible in the header of one newsletter. Subscribers can be targeted by phishing that refers to the newsletter.
Notify authority:: yes
Inform data subjects:: yes
Reasons for delay:: The mailing platform reported the misdirected mail only after the first complaint.

== Response

Actions::
* Kind: containment; What: Stop the campaign and ask the mailing platform to recall the queued mails; Role: role:service-owner; Issues: NS-201; Done: yes
* Kind: recovery; What: Move the recipients to the blind copy field and check every template; Role: role:developer; Issues: NS-202; Done: yes

Timeline::
* At: 2025-09-08T06:40:00Z; What: A subscriber reports that the newsletter shows other addresses.
* At: 2025-09-09T12:00:00Z; What: The templates are corrected and the campaign is sent again.

Resolved at:: 2025-09-09T12:00:00Z

== Review

Root causes::
* Category: software-defect; Description: The template put the recipients in the visible address field.
* Category: third-party; Description: The mailing platform did not warn about more than one visible recipient.

Measures::
* What: Test every campaign template with two recipients before the first send; Role: role:developer; Issues: NS-210; Due: 2025-11-15

== Course

A newsletter went to all subscribers with every address visible. The template was corrected within a day.

== Root-cause analysis

A change to the template replaced the blind copy field by the normal one. No test sent a mail to more than one recipient.

== Lessons

A deadline is only as good as the first report. The complaint reached the team two days after the mail; the reporting path of the mailing platform must name the security team.
